name: race_pair_stacking_every_wave_not_dominant
description: Tide Race (M8), crews of two: stacking every wave does not reliably win a race for a crew of two either, now that a life costs a race what the tide_race preset's life_t says. For each pair of the complementary two (the Lamplighter and the Lookout, the Bellfounder and the Beekeeper) and of each M2 Builder beside each M6 one, a mirror of crews, every plan bot by command and Ready at once in every window, played on past the decision: team 0's two stack every wave they may, team 1's each only its own plan's list (beside a present partner a seat calls only its own list, so most crews of two never stack: the lists share a wave only for the Lamplighter and the Beekeeper). The crew stacking every wave wins at most half the six races (those whose defence holds three waves at once and loses no life to it), the crews stacking their lists win the others, and in every race the first crew stacked more. Generated by tools/gen_balance_scenarios.py: edit the generator, not this file.

steps.assert: series['rows'].size() == 6 and series['wins'][0] * 2 <= 6 and series['wins'][0] + series['wins'][1] == 6 and series['rows'][0]['stacked'][0] > series['rows'][0]['stacked'][1] and series['rows'][1]['stacked'][0] > series['rows'][1]['stacked'][1] and series['rows'][2]['stacked'][0] > series['rows'][2]['stacked'][1] and series['rows'][3]['stacked'][0] > series['rows'][3]['stacked'][1] and series['rows'][4]['stacked'][0] > series['rows'][4]['stacked'][1] and series['rows'][5]['stacked'][0] > series['rows'][5]['stacked'][1]
steps.msg: the crew of two stacking every wave wins at most half the races and the crews stacking their lists the rest; the first stacked more in every race
